## What it is

A short piece of the bar, one opening, and the curved slot the base ring sits in. Print this before the four towers.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. Offer the slotted end up to the ring.
- The opening is the same outward C as the towers. Bore 13.4 mm, mouth 11.5 mm, wall 1.6 mm.
- Snap the link off and set the tab into the gauge before printing the towers.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't treat a coupon that fits as proof the coil is the right length. It checks the slot and one opening.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: the coupon carries the curved base slot instead of a rectangular gauge.
